environment.description: Identical Node.js 18 Express application on ECS Fargate behind the same ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection routed through RDS Proxy. The database role used by the application ('ro_search_svc') was provisioned via Terraform with a narrowly scoped GRANT: only SELECT privilege on columns (id, username, display_name, email, created_at, bio) of the 'users', 'posts', and 'comments' tables. The role has pg_read_all_data revoked explicitly, no USAGE on information_schema or pg_catalog beyond default, and the role property NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE is set. A pg_hba.conf entry restricts this role to connections only from the RDS Proxy security group CIDR. Note: there is no WAF or application-layer SQL filtering — the control is purely at the database permission boundary.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS via RDS Proxy
config.db_privileges: GRANT SELECT (id, username, display_name, email, created_at, bio) ON users TO ro_search_svc; GRANT SELECT (id, title, body, author_id, created_at) ON posts TO ro_search_svc; GRANT SELECT (id, post_id, body, author_id, created_at) ON comments TO ro_search_svc;
config.revocations: REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA information_schema FROM ro_search_svc; REVOKE pg_read_all_data FROM ro_search_svc;
config.network: ALB -> ECS Fargate -> RDS Proxy -> RDS (no WAF)
